properties.displayName: Authentication ASIM parser for Zscaler Private Access
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled:bool=false, pack:bool = false) {
  ZPA_CL
  | where not(disabled)
  | where Message has "SessionStatus"
  | where Message !has "SessionType"
  | parse-kv Message as (
      LogTimestamp: string,
      Customer: string,
      Username: string,
      SessionID: string,
      SessionStatus: string,
      Version: string,
      ZEN: string,
      CertificateCN: string,
      PrivateIP: string,
      PublicIP: string,
      Latitude: real,
      Longitude: real,
      CountryCode: string,
      TimestampAuthentication: string,
      TimestampUnAuthentication: string,
      TotalBytesRx: long,
      TotalBytesTx: long,
      Idp: string,
      Hostname: string,
      Platform: string,
      ClientType: string,
      TrustedNetworks: string,
      TrustedNetworksNames: string,
      SAMLAttributes: string,
      PosturesHit: string,
      PosturesMiss: string,
      ZENLatitude: real,
      ZENLongitude: real,
      ZENCountryCode: string,
      FQDNRegistered: string,
      FQDNRegisteredError: string,
      City: string,
      MicroTenantID: string
    ) with (pair_delimiter=',', kv_delimiter=':', quote='"')
  | where SessionStatus in ("ZPN_STATUS_AUTHENTICATED", "ZPN_STATUS_AUTH_FAILED", "ZPN_STATUS_DISCONNECTED")
  | extend SrcIsFqdn = Hostname matches regex @"^[A-Za-z0-9-]+(\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)+$"
  | invoke _ASIM_ResolveSrcFQDN("Hostname")
  | extend
      // --- Common fields ---
      EventCount = int(1),
      EventStartTime = coalesce(todatetime(TimestampAuthentication), TimeGenerated),
      EventEndTime = case(
          SessionStatus == "ZPN_STATUS_DISCONNECTED", coalesce(todatetime(TimestampUnAuthentication), TimeGenerated),
          coalesce(todatetime(TimestampAuthentication), TimeGenerated)),
      EventType = case (
          SessionStatus in ("ZPN_STATUS_AUTHENTICATED", "ZPN_STATUS_AUTH_FAILED"),  "Logon",
          SessionStatus == "ZPN_STATUS_DISCONNECTED", "Logoff",
          ""),
      EventResult = case (
          SessionStatus in ("ZPN_STATUS_AUTHENTICATED", "ZPN_STATUS_DISCONNECTED"),  "Success",
          SessionStatus == "ZPN_STATUS_AUTH_FAILED", "Failure",
          "NA"),
      EventResultDetails = iif(SessionStatus =~ "ZPN_STATUS_AUTH_FAILED", "Other", ""),
      EventOriginalResultDetails = SessionStatus,
      EventOriginalType = SessionStatus,
      EventProductVersion = Version,
      EventVendor = "Zscaler",
      EventProduct = "Private Access",
      EventSchema = "Authentication",
      EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
      EventUid = _ItemId,
      Dvc = ZEN,
      DvcHostname = ZEN,
      TargetHostname = ZEN
  | extend
      // --- Authentication-specific ---
      LogonMethod = "Other"
  | extend 
      // --- Actor ---
      ActorUsername = Username,
      ActorUsernameType = case (
          isempty(Username), "",
          // "ZPA MACHINE@DESKTOP-01" looks like a UPN but is not one.
          Username startswith "ZPA MACHINE@", "Simple",
          Username matches regex @"^[^@\\]+@[A-Za-z0-9.\-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$", "UPN",
          Username has "\\", "Windows",
          "Simple"),
      ActorUserType = case (
          isempty(Username), "",
          ClientType == "zpn_client_type_machine_tunnel" or Username startswith "ZPA MACHINE@", "Machine",
          ClientType in ("zpn_client_type_slogger", "zpn_client_type_exporter",
                         "zpn_client_type_exporter_noauth", "zpn_client_type_branch_connector",
                         "zpn_client_type_edge_connector", "zpn_client_type_ip_anchoring",
                         "zpn_client_type_browser_isolation"), "Service",
          Username has "@", "Regular",
          "Other"),
      ActorOriginalUserType = ClientType,
      ActorSessionId = SessionID
  // | extend 
  | extend
      // --- Target user ---
      TargetUsername = ActorUsername,
      TargetUsernameType = ActorUsernameType,
      TargetUserType = ActorUserType,
      TargetOriginalUserType = ClientType,
      TargetSessionId = ActorSessionId,
      User = ActorUsername
  | extend 
      // --- Source ---
      Src = coalesce(PublicIP, PrivateIP, Hostname),
      SrcDeviceType = case(
          Platform in~ ("windows", "mac", "linux"), "Computer",
          Platform in~ ("ios", "android"), "Mobile Device",
          isempty(Platform), "",
          "Other"),
      SrcHostname = iif(SrcIsFqdn, SrcHostname, Hostname),
      SrcDomain = iif(SrcIsFqdn, SrcDomain, ""),
      SrcDomainType = iif(SrcIsFqdn, SrcDomainType, ""),
      SrcFQDN = iif(SrcIsFqdn, SrcFQDN, ""),
      SrcIpAddr = coalesce(PublicIP, PrivateIP),
      SrcDvcOs = Platform,
      IpAddr = coalesce(PublicIP, PrivateIP),
      SrcGeoCountry   = CountryCode,
      SrcGeoCity      = City,
      SrcGeoLatitude  = Latitude,
      SrcGeoLongitude = Longitude
  | extend
      // --- target application ---
      TargetAppName = "Zscaler Private Access",
      Application = "Zscaler Private Access",
      TargetAppType = "Service",
      LogonTarget = "Zscaler Private Access"
  | extend
      // --- target system ---
      Dst = TargetAppName,
      TargetGeoCountry = ZENCountryCode,
      TargetGeoLatitude = ZENLatitude,
      TargetGeoLongitude = ZENLongitude
  | extend // --- Additional fields ---
      AdditionalFields = iif(true, bag_pack(
          "CertificateCN", CertificateCN,
          "Customer", Customer,
          "ClientPrivateIP", PrivateIP,
          "Idp", Idp,
          "TrustedNetworks", TrustedNetworks,
          "TrustedNetworksNames", TrustedNetworksNames,
          "SAMLAttributes", SAMLAttributes,
          "PosturesHit", PosturesHit,
          "PosturesMiss", PosturesMiss,
          "TotalBytesRx", TotalBytesRx,
          "TotalBytesTx", TotalBytesTx,
          "FQDNRegistered", FQDNRegistered,
          "FQDNRegisteredError", FQDNRegisteredError,
          "MicroTenantID", MicroTenantID), dynamic(null))
  | project 
      TimeGenerated,
      EventCount,
      EventStartTime,
      EventEndTime,
      EventType,
      EventResult,
      EventResultDetails,
      EventOriginalResultDetails,
      EventOriginalType,
      EventProductVersion,
      EventVendor,
      EventProduct,
      EventSchema,
      EventSchemaVersion,
      EventUid,
      Dvc,
      DvcHostname,
      TargetHostname,
      LogonMethod,
      ActorUsername,
      ActorUsernameType,
      ActorUserType,
      ActorSessionId,
      TargetUsername,
      TargetUsernameType,
      TargetUserType,
      TargetSessionId,
      User,
      Src,
      SrcDeviceType,
      SrcHostname,
      SrcDomain,
      SrcDomainType,
      SrcFQDN,
      SrcIpAddr,
      SrcDvcOs,
      IpAddr,
      SrcGeoCountry,
      SrcGeoCity,
      SrcGeoLatitude,
      SrcGeoLongitude,
      TargetAppName,
      Application,
      TargetAppType,
      LogonTarget,
      Dst,
      TargetGeoCountry,
      TargetGeoLatitude,
      TargetGeoLongitude,
      AdditionalFields,
      Type
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
